newsitem.title: CANADA: Ontario wheat board to add forward contracts.
newsitem.headline: Ontario wheat board to add forward contracts.

text.p: A wheat forward contract will be added to the Ontario Wheat Producers' Marketing Board price program after the signup for a pilot project ended successfully June 30, the OWPMB said.
"I feel the program has been successful by allowing growers the opportunity to fix a cash price for wheat," OWPMB chairman Terry Ross said in a statement.
Some 161 contracts were signed for 8,300 tonnes of wheat at an average price of C$200 a tonne, or C$5.45 a bushel, out of a total anticipated production of 565,000 tonnes.
Ontario's winter wheat harvest begins in late July.
The OWPMB holds a monopoly in wheat sales and manages risk through price pooling and government guaranteed "initial," or first partial payment, prices.
